---
title: "Excitation-Inhibition Balance Tuning via tvboptim"
---

Reproducing the FIC+EIB tuning workflow from [Schirner et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38626-y). Fits local inhibitory weights (J_i) for E-I balance and dual coupling weights (wLRE, wFFI) to match empirical functional connectivity.

```{python}
# | output: false
import os

os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = "--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=8"

from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load experiment (network + target FC loaded from BIDS automatically)
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file(
    "/Users/leonmartin_bih/tools/tvbo/database/experiments/EI_Tuning_FIC_EIB_Optimization.yaml"
)
print(exp.render_code('tvboptim'))
```

```{python}
results = exp.run("tvboptim")
pickleable = {
    'fic': {
        'mean_S_e': np.array(results.fic.history.mean_S_e),
        'mean_S_i': np.array(results.fic.history.mean_S_i),
        'bold': np.array(results.fic.history.bold),
        'J_i': np.array(results.fic.state.dynamics.J_i),
    },
    'fic_eib': {
        'fc_corr': np.array(results.fic_eib.history.fc_corr),
        'fc_rmse': np.array(results.fic_eib.history.fc_rmse),
        'mean_S_e': np.array(results.fic_eib.history.mean_S_e),
        'mean_S_i': np.array(results.fic_eib.history.mean_S_i),
        'bold': np.array(results.fic_eib.history.bold),
        'wFFEI': np.array(results.fic_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wFFI),
'wLRE': np.array(results.fic_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE),


    }
}
import pickle
with open('/Users/leonmartin_bih/tools/tvbo/docs/Interoperability/tvboptim/generated_results_200_2000.pkl', 'wb') as f:
    pickle.dump(pickleable, f)
```


## Results
```{python}
# | label: fig-ei-tuning-results
# | fig-cap: "**EI Tuning Results.** Row 1: FIC algorithm. Row 2: FIC+EIB combined. Row 3: Gradient-based optimization."
# | fig-height: 12

cmap = plt.cm.cividis
accent_blue = cmap(0.3)
accent_gold = cmap(0.85)
accent_mid = cmap(0.6)

# Get FC matrices from result structure (observations attached to simulation results)
fc_target = np.array(results.observations.fc_target)
fc_post_fic = np.array(results.fic.post_tuning.observations.fc)
fc_post_fic_eib = np.array(results.fic_eib.post_tuning.observations.fc)
fc_gradient = np.array(results.gradient_eib.simulation.observations.fc)

# FC correlations from post-tuning observations
corr_post_fic = float(results.fic.post_tuning.observations.fc_corr)
corr_fic_eib = float(results.fic_eib.post_tuning.observations.fc_corr)
corr_gradient = float(results.gradient_eib.simulation.observations.fc_corr)

# 3 rows x 4 columns layout
mosaic = "AABBCCDD\nEEFFGGHH\nIIJJKKLL"
fig, axes = plt.subplot_mosaic(mosaic, figsize=(16, 10.5))

# =============================================================================
# ROW 1: FIC Algorithm Results (Local E-I Balance Tuning)
# =============================================================================

# Number of time steps to show (720ms / 4ms dt = 180, matching original)
n_display = 180

# A: S_e Before FIC
ax = axes["A"]
data = np.array(results.fic.pre_tuning.data[:n_display, 0, :])
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(i / data.shape[1]), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls="--", lw=2, label="Target")
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="FIC: Before Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc="upper right")

# B: S_e After FIC
ax = axes["B"]
data = np.array(results.fic.post_tuning.data[:n_display, 0, :])
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(i / data.shape[1]), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls="--", lw=2, label="Target")
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="FIC: After Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc="upper right")

# C: FIC Convergence (Mean S_e over iterations)
ax = axes["C"]
ax.plot(np.array(results.fic.history.mean_S_e), lw=2, color=accent_blue, label="Mean S_e")
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls="--", lw=2, label="Target")
ax.set(xlabel="FIC iteration", ylabel="Mean S_e", title="FIC: Convergence")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# D: FC Target (empirical)
ax = axes["D"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_target)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="Target FC (Empirical)")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# =============================================================================
# ROW 2: FIC+EIB Combined Algorithm Results
# =============================================================================

# E: FC after FIC+EIB
ax = axes["E"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_post_fic_eib)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title=f"FIC+EIB FC (r={corr_fic_eib:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# F: FIC+EIB Convergence (FC correlation)
ax = axes["F"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
(l1,) = ax.plot(np.array(results.fic_eib.history.fc_corr), lw=2, color=accent_blue, label="FC Corr")
(l2,) = ax2.plot(np.array(results.fic_eib.history.fc_rmse), lw=2, color=accent_gold, label="FC RMSE")
ax.set(xlabel="FIC+EIB iteration", ylabel="FC Correlation", title="FIC+EIB: Convergence")
ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc="center right")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# G: FIC+EIB wLRE
ax = axes["G"]
wLRE = np.array(results.fic_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="FIC+EIB: wLRE")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# H: FIC+EIB wFFI
ax = axes["H"]
wFFI = np.array(results.fic_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wFFI)
im = ax.imshow(wFFI, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="FIC+EIB: wFFI")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# =============================================================================
# ROW 3: Gradient-Based Optimization Results
# =============================================================================

# I: FC after Gradient Optimization
ax = axes["I"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_gradient)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title=f"Gradient FC (r={corr_gradient:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# J: Gradient Loss Convergence
ax = axes["J"]
# Access history directly - tvboptim optimizer stores loss in history['loss'].save
loss_values = np.array(results.gradient_eib.history['loss'].save.tolist())
ax.plot(loss_values, lw=2, color="k", alpha=0.9)
ax.scatter(0, loss_values[0], s=80, color=accent_blue, zorder=5)
ax.scatter(len(loss_values) - 1, loss_values[-1], s=80, color=accent_gold, zorder=5)
ax.set(xlabel="Optimization Step", ylabel="Combined Loss", title="Gradient: Loss Convergence")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# K: wLRE after Gradient
ax = axes["K"]
wLRE_grad = np.array(results.gradient_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE_grad, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="Gradient: wLRE")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# L: wFFI after Gradient
ax = axes["L"]
wFFI_grad = np.array(results.gradient_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wFFI)
im = ax.imshow(wFFI_grad, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="Gradient: wFFI")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# =============================================================================
# Summary Statistics
# =============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("EI TUNING SUMMARY")
print("=" * 60)

print(f"\nFIC (Local E-I Balance):")
print(f"  Final Mean S_e: {results.fic.history.mean_S_e[-1]:.4f} (target: 0.25)")
print(f"  FC correlation: {corr_post_fic:.4f}")

print(f"\nFIC+EIB (Combined Algorithm):")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {corr_fic_eib:.4f}")
print(f"  Final FC RMSE: {results.fic_eib.history.fc_rmse[-1]:.4f}")

print(f"\nGradient-Based Optimization:")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {corr_gradient:.4f}")
print(f"  Final combined loss: {loss_values[-1]:.4f}")
print(f"  Improvement over FIC+EIB: Δr = {corr_gradient - corr_fic_eib:+.4f}")
```
